title: Personal credit assessment method and system based on federated learning decision forest

pse.problem: Limitations in traditional personal credit assessment methods due to privacy concerns and inefficiencies in handling heterogeneous data.
pse.solution_function: Constructs a decision forest for personal credit assessment in federated learning scenarios while maintaining user privacy protection and high classification accuracy.
pse.solution_structure: Uses local optimal attributes and global optimal attributes to create new nodes in the decision forest.
pse.solution_implementation: In federated learning, each data holder trains a local model using their own private data. The local models are then aggregated to form a global model which is used for personal credit assessment.
pse.effect: Improved privacy protection and high classification accuracy in heterogeneous data scenarios
